alt.printed: Three panels of whole-answer accuracy against puzzle length, for chains, pieces and both pooled, in the length sweep on other puzzles. Each model's accuracies are joined by a line in length order, with a 95% bar on each point (hollow markers in the pieces panel); Sonnet-medium and Opus-medium are shifted a little to the left and to the right of each length to keep the markers and bars of one length apart, and Haiku-medium stands at its true length. A grey dashed line with a light band is the reference q^N, built from Haiku-medium's per-piece accuracy; it is labelled once, in panel A, Haiku-medium q^N (not fitted), with a short grey leader from the label to the line. Panel B's title says its markers are hollow.
The reference line, the independent-pieces line, reaches
